identity.title: A committed firm serving sustainable development
identity.ambition: Turn environmental, social and climate challenges into levers for action, peace and resilience for African communities and territories.

paragraphs: Social & Eco Impact (SEI) is a consulting, research and strategy firm working on sustainable land management, environmental and social impact assessment, and responses to peace, mobility and climate change challenges.

SEI supports public institutions, local authorities, international organisations, and technical and financial partners in designing, implementing, monitoring and evaluating high-impact policies, strategies, projects and programmes across Africa.

history.title: Our history
history.heading: Field expertise, in service of Africa
history.statement: From the Rio Conventions to the Great Green Wall.
paragraphs: Founded in 2024 and operational since 2026, Social & Eco Impact (SEI) is a firm based in Tunis, working with States, institutions, development partners, businesses and communities across Africa.

SEI was born from its founder's experience implementing the three Rio Conventions on biodiversity, climate change and desertification. His international career, notably within the Sahara and Sahel Observatory (OSS), was built through coordinating and implementing projects and programmes carried out in partnership with the Global Mechanism of the United Nations Convention to Combat Desertification (UNCCD) and the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP). It was further enriched by experience with the main international environmental and climate finance mechanisms, including the Adaptation Fund, the Green Climate Fund and the Global Environment Facility.

Having coordinated major environmental and climate projects and led numerous field missions and institutional support assignments with ministries in Benin, Burkina Faso, Niger, the Central African Republic, the Republic of Guinea, Seychelles and Tunisia, its founder gained a concrete understanding of the realities facing African territories.

His career has also been marked by an active contribution to implementing the Great Green Wall Initiative, notably through leading stakeholder consultation and coordination mechanisms, as well as designing and developing regional projects dedicated to land restoration, climate change adaptation and strengthening community resilience.

This experience gave rise to a strong conviction: international commitments and public policies only deliver lasting results when translated into concrete solutions, adapted to local realities and designed as close as possible to their beneficiaries.

SEI was created to bring technical expertise, international standards and financing mechanisms closer to the real needs of territories. The firm supports its partners in the sustainable management of land and natural resources, the assessment and management of environmental and social risks, climate change adaptation, biodiversity conservation, and the design of transformative, inclusive and resilient projects.

values.title: Our values
values.heading: Integrity, accountability and fairness
values.statement: Principles that guide every intervention we lead.
values.text: At SEI, we place integrity, accountability and fairness at the heart of our commitment. We favour listening and dialogue, combining institutional expertise with the knowledge and realities of communities. Our interventions are built on rigour, transparency and the pursuit of concrete, inclusive and sustainable solutions, generating tangible, measurable results for the benefit of communities and ecosystems.

vision.title: Our vision
vision.heading: More resilient African territories
vision.text: Contributing to more resilient African territories, where the sustainable management of natural resources protects ecosystems, secures community livelihoods and prevents tensions exacerbated by climate change.

expertiseIntro.title: Natural capital and territorial resilience at the heart of our interventions
expertiseIntro.text: SEI supports the integrated implementation of, and synergies between, the Rio Conventions on biodiversity, climate change and desertification. Our expertise helps restore land and ecosystems, manage environmental and social risks, and strengthen the resilience of communities and territories.

expertises.title: Sustainable Land Management and LDN
expertises.summary: SEI supports public actors and their partners in sustainable land management and in achieving Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN). Our expertise covers the prevention and reduction of degradation, the restoration of land and ecosystems, and the planning and monitoring of national commitments.

interventions.title: Ecological rehabilitation and sustainable repurposing of degraded mining sites
interventions.text: Diagnostic studies, restoration planning, support for soil rehabilitation, revegetation and the definition of sustainable land uses — including agricultural uses where soil quality allows.

interventions.title: Data production, mapping and monitoring of land degradation
interventions.text: Assessment of degradation trends, identification of priority areas, definition of Land Degradation Neutrality (LDN) targets and measurement of intervention effectiveness using GIS, remote sensing and monitoring indicators.

interventions.title: Integration of LDN into policy and territorial planning
interventions.text: Support to institutions in mainstreaming LDN objectives into national and territorial development policies, strategies, investment plans and programmes.

interventions.title: Institutional and technical capacity building
interventions.text: Design of training programmes, guides, operational manuals and decision-support tools, complemented by hands-on support to institutions, local authorities and field actors.

interventions.title: Project design and resource mobilisation
interventions.text: Development of concept notes, feasibility studies and funding proposals dedicated to sustainable land management, ecosystem restoration and the achievement of LDN.

expertises.impact: Restore the ecological and productive functions of degraded land, support sustainable food production and guide public action through reliable data, to accelerate progress towards Land Degradation Neutrality.

expertises.title: Environmental and Social Assessment
expertises.summary: SEI supports project developers in identifying, assessing and managing environmental and social risks throughout the lifecycle of their interventions. Our approach aims to preserve ecosystems, protect communities and support the delivery of responsible projects that comply with national regulations and international standards.

interventions.title: Environmental and social assessments
interventions.text: Environmental and social impact assessments (ESIA), impact notices (NIES) and strategic environmental assessments, including risk analysis, effects on ecosystems and communities, and the definition of appropriate mitigation measures.

interventions.title: Development and operationalisation of environmental and social management instruments
interventions.text: Design of environmental and social management plans (ESMP), procedures, budgets and monitoring indicators, together with support for their implementation and the application of corrective measures.

interventions.title: Stakeholder engagement and mobilisation
interventions.text: Stakeholder mapping, inclusive consultations, development of engagement plans and the establishment of accessible grievance mechanisms.

interventions.title: Gender mainstreaming and inclusion of vulnerable groups
interventions.text: Social and gender analyses, definition of inclusion measures and integration of dedicated indicators to prevent disproportionate impacts and promote equitable participation.

interventions.title: Environmental and social audit, monitoring and reporting
interventions.text: Compliance audits and field monitoring missions, development of dashboards and preparation of reports meeting regulatory requirements and financial partners' standards.

expertises.impact: Anticipate and manage environmental and social risks, reduce impacts on ecosystems and communities, and strengthen the acceptability, compliance and long-term performance of projects.

expertises.title: Peace, Mobility and Climate Change
expertises.summary: SEI supports institutions, territories and communities in anticipating the effects of climate change on natural resources, livelihoods and human mobility. Our approach aims to strengthen community resilience, prevent tensions linked to access to resources and promote inclusive responses adapted to local realities.

interventions.title: Collaborative planning and prevention of natural resource conflicts
interventions.text: Participatory diagnostics and development of action plans, charters or local agreements promoting shared management of land, water, pastoral areas and transhumance.

interventions.title: Prevention and management of climate risks
interventions.text: Vulnerability analyses, development of prevention and preparedness plans, support to early warning systems and strengthening of institutional coordination at local, national and regional levels.

interventions.title: Anticipating climate-related mobility and displacement
interventions.text: Analysis of environmental and climatic mobility drivers, mapping of at-risk areas and integration of anticipation and support measures into territorial policies and plans.

interventions.title: Development of local climate-smart agriculture strategies
interventions.text: Design and implementation of strategies adapted to local realities, integrating sustainable land and water management, improved agricultural practices and strengthened producer capacities.

interventions.title: Diversification of resilient livelihoods
interventions.text: Identification and development of inclusive economic activities, sustainable value chains and income diversification solutions, with particular attention to women, youth and vulnerable groups.

expertises.impact: Reduce climate vulnerabilities, secure access to natural resources and livelihoods, anticipate mobility and prevent tensions to strengthen the resilience and social cohesion of territories.

approach.title: Connecting international commitments to territorial realities
approach.lead: SEI combines a cross-cutting reading of environmental, social, climate and territorial issues with a solid understanding of institutional and socioeconomic realities. Our approach relies on the active participation of institutions, communities, civil society organisations and other stakeholders, together with operational tools that inform decisions, manage risks and durably strengthen the resilience of territories.

items.title: Capacity building and knowledge management
items.text: Needs assessments, design and delivery of training, development of guides and practical tools, capitalisation and dissemination of knowledge, stakeholder awareness-raising and support for institutional and technical capacity building.

items.title: Design and organisation of strategic events
items.text: Design and organisation of international conferences, high-level dialogues, multi-stakeholder workshops and side events. SEI supports the definition of themes, the mobilisation of speakers and partners, content preparation, facilitation, communication and the capitalisation of outcomes.

approach.closingTitle: Interventions at the heart of the 2030 Agenda
approach.closingText: SEI's interventions contribute directly to several Sustainable Development Goals, particularly those related to climate action, land restoration and biodiversity conservation, peace and effective institutions, and partnerships. Our integrated approach translates these global goals into concrete action for the benefit of people and territories.

capabilities.title: Expertise mobilised for impact
capabilities.lead: SEI’s cross-cutting capabilities strengthen the technical quality, coherence and operational reach of all its interventions.

items.title: Integrated implementation and synergies across the Rio Conventions
items.text: Supporting Party countries in implementing their commitments under the Rio Conventions, by building synergies across biodiversity, climate and desertification issues, and integrating them coherently into national sustainable development strategies.

items.title: Project development and stakeholder mobilisation
items.text: Designing transformative projects aligned with national priorities and international standards, through inclusive dialogue and stakeholder consultations.

items.title: Capacity building and knowledge management
items.text: Designing and delivering training, capturing and sharing knowledge, raising stakeholder awareness, and supporting institutional capacity building.

valueAdded.label: Our added value
valueAdded.text: SEI combines technical expertise, in-depth knowledge of local dynamics, technological innovation and active stakeholder participation. This integrated approach delivers reliable, data-driven solutions tailored to territorial realities in order to restore land and ecosystems, manage environmental and social risks, prevent tensions and sustainably strengthen community resilience.
